AF_ISSUE_PROMPT_OfferHeader: [Vanilla quest context (for understanding only; do not copy verbatim)]
AF_ISSUE_PROMPT_OfferOpening: You currently have a vanilla quest you can offer to the player.
AF_ISSUE_PROMPT_OfferBrief: Your vanilla explanation to the player: {BRIEF}
AF_ISSUE_PROMPT_OfferPersonalSolution: Vanilla explanation of the player's personal solution: {DETAIL}
AF_ISSUE_PROMPT_OfferBaseReward: Vanilla base reward reference: {GOLD} denars. This is reference information only; you do not need to quote the exact amount.
AF_ISSUE_PROMPT_OfferEligible: The player currently meets the acceptance conditions. If the player clearly agrees to take this quest, give only a natural verbal confirmation or acceptance in the body; do not output any action tag. Whether the quest is actually accepted is determined by post-processing from your response.
AF_ISSUE_PROMPT_OfferReject: The player does not meet the vanilla prerequisites for accepting this quest; refuse firmly.
AF_ISSUE_PROMPT_OfferReason: Vanilla reason this quest cannot currently be offered: {REASON}
AF_ISSUE_PROMPT_OfferAlternativeAvailabl: This quest also supports being handled by one of the player's companions.
AF_ISSUE_PROMPT_OfferAlternativeConsent: If the player explicitly asks for a companion to handle it and clearly names one of the candidates below, give only a natural verbal agreement in the body to that companion taking the assignment; post-processing decides whether it is actually assigned to them.
AF_ISSUE_PROMPT_OfferAskCompanion: If the player only says to send a companion without naming anyone, ask a follow-up question first; do not treat the assignment as decided.
AF_ISSUE_PROMPT_OfferCandidateList: You may choose only from the following candidates; never invent a companion:
AF_ISSUE_PROMPT_OfferTroopDispatchInfo: If post-processing confirms a companion assignment, the native troop-dispatch screen will open next to choose accompanying soldiers. In your response, decide only whether to accept and who will lead.
AF_ISSUE_PROMPT_InProgressInstruction: You have already assigned a vanilla quest to the player. Do not offer it again as if for the first time, and do not output any quest-acceptance tag.
AF_ISSUE_PROMPT_InProgressStateAlternati: The player delegated the quest to a companion. If the player claims the quest is complete, they are lying.
AF_ISSUE_PROMPT_InProgressStateSelf: The player is carrying out the quest personally; it is not complete yet. If the player claims it is complete, they are lying.
AF_ISSUE_PROMPT_InProgressDiscussion: Respond to the player's words about progress, remind them of requirements, and say whether the task appears close to completion; do not reintroduce the question of accepting it.
AF_ISSUE_PROMPT_NoActionTags: Never output [ACTION:ISSUE_ACCEPT_SELF], [ACTION:ISSUE_ACCEPT_ALT:*], or [ACTION:QUEST_TURN_IN] in the body; post-processing alone decides whether to trigger them.
AF_ISSUE_PROMPT_TurnInHeader: [Vanilla quest context: ready to turn in]
AF_ISSUE_PROMPT_TurnInIntro: The vanilla system has confirmed a turn-in path is currently available. Do not issue the quest again; focus on checking and confirming results and discussing completion.
AF_ISSUE_PROMPT_TurnInDiscussIntro: Opening meaning from the current vanilla discuss flow: {TEXT}
AF_ISSUE_PROMPT_TurnInCompletionSignal: Explicit completion signal detected by the system: {TEXT}
AF_ISSUE_PROMPT_TurnInVisibleOptions: Summary of currently visible vanilla player options:
AF_ISSUE_PROMPT_TurnInReady: The player has met the quest's completion conditions. If they say they are turning it in, confirm it is done, or come for inspection, naturally confirm completion or point out that it is still incomplete; do not output any action tag. Post-processing decides whether it is actually turned in.
AF_ISSUE_PROMPT_TurnInUnclear: If the player is only asking for progress, has not finished, or is unclear, respond normally and do not state that the quest has been inspected and completed.
AF_ISSUE_PROMPT_RecentInstruction: The player has just completed a vanilla quest you assigned. Do not issue it again or output any quest-acceptance tag.
AF_ISSUE_PROMPT_RecentScope: This recently completed fact applies only to the next conversation and means the old quest has already been resolved.
AF_ISSUE_PROMPT_RecentOtherQuests: If you have another vanilla quest to discuss now, you may continue with a new one; do not treat this completed old quest as unfinished or assign the same old quest again.
AF_ISSUE_PROMPT_NoAvailable: [Vanilla quest context: no available quest] {GIVER} currently has no vanilla quest to offer.
AF_CONV_UI_Issue_NoOfferable: No vanilla quest is currently available to accept.
AF_CONV_UI_Issue_PreconditionsNotMet: You do not currently meet the requirements to accept this quest.
AF_CONV_UI_Issue_CannotAcceptReason: Cannot accept this quest right now: {REASON}
AF_CONV_UI_Issue_ManagerUnavailable: IssueManager is unavailable; cannot start quest.
AF_CONV_UI_Issue_FinalizeFailed: Quest was created, but failed to finalize vanilla acceptance.
AF_CONV_UI_Issue_AcceptException: An error occurred while accepting the quest.
AF_CONV_UI_Issue_AltDispatchPending: A companion dispatch screen is already pending confirmation.
AF_CONV_UI_Issue_NoAltSolution: This quest cannot be solved by a companion right now.
AF_CONV_UI_Issue_CompanionNotAllowed: The chosen companion is not in the allowed list.
AF_CONV_UI_Issue_CompanionConfirmedSelec: Confirmed that {HERO} will lead. Please select the accompanying troops.
AF_CONV_UI_Issue_AltStartException: An error occurred while starting the companion solution.
AF_CONV_UI_Issue_AltConfirmException: An error occurred while confirming companion assignment.
AF_CONV_UI_Issue_CompanionNotInParty: This companion is not in your main party.
AF_CONV_UI_Issue_NoEligibleCompanion: No eligible companion is available in your party.
AF_CONV_UI_Issue_NoTurnInQuest: No quest available to turn in via conversation.
AF_CONV_UI_Issue_TurnInFailed: Failed to turn in vanilla quest.
AF_CONV_UI_Issue_DispatchCancelled: Companion mission troop dispatch was cancelled.
AF_CONV_UI_Issue_TroopsNotSatisfied: Selected troops do not meet the quest requirements.
AF_CONV_UI_Issue_TroopsNotSatisfiedReaso: Selected troops do not meet the quest requirements: {REASON}
AF_CONV_UI_Issue_NoQuestOrGiver: No quest or quest giver was found.
AF_CONV_UI_Issue_QuestNotCreated: The quest object was not created.
AF_CONV_UI_Issue_AcceptBranchEnded: The vanilla acceptance branch ended or removed the quest immediately, so it never reached the normal in-progress state.
AF_CONV_UI_Issue_QuestNotOngoing: The quest did not enter the in-progress state.
AF_CONV_UI_Issue_AcceptFinalizeException: An error occurred while finalizing the vanilla quest acceptance.
AF_CONV_UI_Issue_NoOngoingVanillaQuest: There is no ongoing vanilla quest right now.
AF_CONV_UI_Issue_NoDiscussFlow: The current quest has no usable vanilla discuss flow.
AF_CONV_UI_Issue_DiscussAgentMissing: The Agent required for the vanilla discuss probe could not be found in the current scene.
AF_CONV_UI_Issue_ConversationManagerUnav: The vanilla ConversationManager is not available for silent quest turn-in.
AF_CONV_UI_Issue_NoClearTurnInOption: The vanilla discuss flow has no sufficiently clear successful turn-in option.
AF_CONV_UI_Issue_TurnInProbeException: An error occurred while turning in the vanilla quest: {REASON}
AF_CONV_UI_Issue_TurnInMissingArgs: Missing the vanilla quest turn-in execution parameters.
AF_CONV_UI_Issue_TurnInAmbiguousBranch: The vanilla turn-in chain branched into multiple paths and could not be auto-selected with high confidence.
AF_CONV_UI_Issue_TurnInNotCompleted: The vanilla turn-in chain ran, but the quest is still not completed.
